services:
  selenium-hub:
    image: selenium/hub:4.35.0-20250909
    ports:
      - "4442:4442"
  chrome:
    image: selenium/node-chrome:4.35.0-20250909
    shm_size: 2gb
    depends_on:
      - selenium-hub
    environment:
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST=selenium-hub
